_doc: Season windows for the PUBLIC SITE's marketing copy — the one place they are written down.
Two window sets per season, MM-DD, inclusive, in the visitor's local calendar:
page  — when the town-page hero, price block and pillar hero lead with the season
(read by js/season.js — the build stamps this file into it, see below).
meta  — when each town page's <title> / meta description carry the seasonal
suffix (read by scripts/sync-seasonal-meta.mjs at build time). Starts two
weeks before `page` because Google needs 1–3 weeks to re-crawl and show
the new snippet; ends the same day the hero flips.
Anything outside both windows is the off-season.
Sub-phases the pillar page's hero controller keys off (js/season.js only):
fall.preUntil   — last day of the 'pre-fall' phase inside the fall page window
(Aug 15 – preUntil = pre-fall, after = fall).
spring.preFrom  — first day of the 'pre-spring' phase before the spring page
window (preFrom – Mar 14 = pre-spring). Nov 21 – preFrom-1 = winter.
Jun 16 – Aug 14 (between the windows) = midseason.
js/season.js runs synchronously in <head> so the hero paints in the right season with
no flash; it cannot fetch this file. scripts/sync-seasonal-meta.mjs copies this JSON
into js/season.js between its @@PJL:season-config markers on every build and the
--check mode fails if the two ever differ. Edit THIS file, then run npm run build.
These are MARKETING windows. The operational season (first/last day a truck rolls,
public booking cut-offs) is a separate setting in seasons.json.
